terra.problem: “Not this one” suggests Aaron does not tend the lamps at noon. The passage specifies evening until morning but does not say he cannot tend them at noon.
The bronze altar of burnt offering was outside the Tent of Meeting, not a spot in the Tent (Exodus 40:6, 29).
The passage says the bread is set out every Sabbath, but it does not say it is baked weekly.
“I was wrong about that too” implicitly calls the baker's answer wrong. The mystery key also needs to be identified as a friend from Papa Dorin's drawer.
“You've got a big heart” assumes something about the individual baker from the answer they picked.
“One place” suggests a single specific location. The passage says a holy place, without specifying one particular place.
